summary: Crypto holders in the United States reportedly received fraudulent physical letters impersonating the IRS and directing recipients to enroll in a fake Digital Asset Compliance Portal. The letters used a QR code leading to a phishing website designed to collect personal and crypto-related information.
prevention: Verify unexpected tax notices through official IRS channels / Never scan QR codes in unsolicited letters to access crypto or tax portals
classification_warning: physical mail QR code phishing campaign
